about: Новые глюки: гиковский трэш с чёрным юмором. Каждый — мертвец, неудачник или кошмар из интернета. Все свои типажи, без чужих персонажей.

foes.name: Зомби-модератор
foes.joke: Умер на посту — в буквальном смысле. Банит всё, что движется.
foes.look: a pale-green undead internet forum moderator in his forties, greasy comb-over plastered across a cracked scalp, sunken eyes behind thick cracked glasses held together with tape, a slack jaw with a few yellow teeth; he wears a stained grey zip hoodie over a faded t-shirt with a shield badge showing a crossed-out speech bubble, saggy sweatpants and worn house slippers
foes.physics: the hoodie sags under its own weight with a dark coffee stain dried stiff across the belly, the sweatpants bag at the knees, and the slippers are flattened at the heels
foes.split: the hoodie sleeves split at the elbow with a ribbed cuff at the wrist, the sweatpants split at the knee
foes.props: a huge wooden banhammer with a chipped head and a wrapped grip, sized to fit the gripping hand

foes.name: Курьер-призрак
foes.joke: Сбит самокатом на последнем заказе. Всё ещё везёт ваш ролл «Филадельфия».
foes.look: a translucent pale-blue ghost of a young delivery courier, cheeks hollow, a faint tire track printed across his chest and one cheek, a cheap rain poncho over a branded-free hoodie, a phone strapped to his forearm, sneakers with flapping soles; a huge cube-shaped insulated delivery backpack is strapped to his back
foes.physics: the poncho flutters backward as if he is always rushing, rainwater drips off its hem, and the backpack drags his shoulders down with its weight
foes.split: the poncho sleeves split at the elbow, the trousers split at the knee; the delivery backpack is drawn as part of the torso pieces
foes.props: a paper takeaway bag with a stapled receipt, sized to fit the gripping hand

foes.name: Скелет рейд-лидера
foes.joke: Сутки не вставал из-за компа ради легендарки. Так и не выпала.
foes.look: a grinning skeleton raid leader, bones yellowed and dusty, cobwebs between the ribs, a chunky gaming headset with a boom mic clamped over his skull, a ragged oversized gaming hoodie hanging off the bones, cargo shorts and one sock
foes.physics: the hoodie hangs loose on the bare bones and swings with every move, dust puffs off the joints, and the headset cable dangles down to the knee
foes.split: the hoodie sleeves split at the elbow over bare bone forearms, the bony legs split at the knee
foes.props: a gaming mouse on a long cable swung like a flail, and an empty crushed energy-drink can with no brand

foes.name: Пират-торрентщик
foes.joke: Качал всё бесплатно. Теперь качается сам — на волнах ада.
foes.look: an undead pirate captain with grey rotting skin, a bushy dirty orange beard, a black eyepatch with a tiny floppy-disk emblem, a dark tricorn hat with a white skull-and-crossed-cables badge, a red-and-white striped shirt, a wide leather belt and dark breeches; a parrot made from a USB stick with feathers glued on sits on his shoulder
foes.physics: the beard is matted and swings heavily, the striped shirt is torn at the hem, and seawater drips from the breeches
foes.split: the shirt sleeves split at the elbow, the breeches split at the knee; the parrot is part of the torso piece; the tricorn hat and beard are part of the head
foes.props: a cutlass whose blade is a cracked shiny compact disc, and a wooden peg leg drawn as one straight vertical piece the length of shin plus foot

foes.name: Стример-трупак
foes.joke: Стримил марафон без сна. Чат так и не заметил. Встаёт ещё раз: «чат, я вернулся».
foes.look: a dead young streamer with grey-violet skin and stitched-up cheek, dark circles, bleached hair with dark roots, a big over-ear headset, a tight graphic tee with an abstract logo, a clip-on webcam on his collar, joggers and slides; a ring light halo stands behind his head like a saint's nimbus
foes.physics: the ring light casts a flat white rim on his hair and shoulders, the headset cable is tangled around his neck, and the joggers wrinkle at the knees
foes.split: the tee sleeves end on the upper arm with bare forearms, the joggers split at the knee; the ring light halo is part of the head piece
foes.props: a selfie stick with a cracked phone, sized to fit the gripping hand

foes.name: Сисадмин-вампир
foes.joke: Двадцать лет не видел солнца. Пьёт кофе группы крови «арабика».
foes.look: a gaunt vampire system administrator with paper-white skin, slicked black hair with a widow's peak, red sleepless eyes, small fangs, a wrinkled black shirt with rolled sleeves, a lanyard with an access card, black trousers and orthopedic sandals with socks; a long cape made of tangled grey and blue network cables hangs from his shoulders
foes.physics: the cable cape drags on the floor and its loose plugs click together, the shirt is creased from sleeping at the desk, and the lanyard swings over the chest
foes.split: the shirt sleeves end rolled just below the elbow on the forearm piece, the trousers split at the knee
foes.props: a chipped office mug stained red inside, and a tangled bundle of patch cords

foes.name: Коллекционер в блистере
foes.joke: Никогда не открывал коробку, чтобы не упала цена. Его тоже никто не открывал.
foes.role: танк: блистер трескается на половине здоровья
foes.look: a pudgy middle-aged toy collector sealed inside a giant clear plastic blister pack glued to a printed cardboard backing card, mint-in-box, with a fake price sticker and a hang tab above his head; under the plastic he wears a too-small superhero-style t-shirt without any logo, khaki shorts and white socks
foes.physics: the clear plastic blister has hard creases and bright flat glints, it presses his cheeks and belly flat where it touches, and the cardboard card behind him is bent at the corners
foes.split: the blister front shell and the cardboard card are drawn as separate pieces, not fused to the body; the t-shirt sleeves end on the upper arm, the shorts split at the knee
foes.props: the clear blister front shell as one separate piece, the same shell cracked and caved in as a second piece, and the cardboard backing card
foes.mood: smug and protective of his value

foes.name: Культист-мастер подземелий
foes.joke: Двадцать лет водил одну кампанию. Игроки давно умерли. Он — нет.
foes.look: a hooded cultist dungeon master in a robe made from a striped bedsheet tied with a bathrobe belt, a translucent purple d20 hanging on a cord around his neck, glowing eyes under the hood, a scraggly beard and Cheetos dust on his fingers
foes.physics: the bedsheet robe has crisp fold lines from the packet, it drags on the floor and is singed at the hem, and the d20 pendant swings and catches the light
foes.split: the wide robe sleeves split at the elbow; the lower robe is drawn as one separate bell-shaped skirt piece from waist to ankles, with plain legs and slippers underneath
foes.props: a folded cardboard game-master screen used as a shield, a rubber chicken held like a sacrificial dagger, and a small cardboard goblin minion standing on its own
foes.mood: theatrical, menacing and a bit sad

foes.name: Рептилоид из ютуба
foes.joke: Сам снял видео про рептилоидов. Досмотрел до конца.
foes.look: a lizard man in an ill-fitting cheap grey business suit and loosened tie, green scaly skin, vertical slit pupils, a forked tongue flicking out, a hat folded from tinfoil on his head, and a cheap earpiece
foes.physics: the suit jacket is a size too big and bunches at the shoulders, the tinfoil hat crinkles with sharp flat highlights, and his tail pokes out from under the jacket
foes.split: the suit sleeves split at the elbow, the trousers split at the knee; the tail is drawn as one separate curved piece; the tinfoil hat is part of the head
foes.props: a cork board with photos and red strings, sized to be held in front of the chest

foes.name: Диктатор в пачке
foes.joke: Сатира: самый злой человек века, вечно униженный в розовой балетной пачке.
foes.look: a satirical caricature of a furious 1940s dictator dressed as a ballerina: a small angry man with a black side-parted fringe glued flat and a small rectangular toothbrush moustache, a pink ballet leotard, bare arms, white tights and pink pointe shoes with ribbons; no uniform, no symbols, no armbands, no insignia of any kind
foes.physics: the layered tulle tutu sticks out stiffly and bounces, the tights wrinkle at the ankles, and the pointe shoes are scuffed
foes.split: the tutu is drawn as part of the pelvis piece, sticking out sideways; the tights split at the knee; the feet stand on pointe
foes.props: none, leave the props area empty

foes.name: Сосед с перфоратором
foes.joke: Ремонт с 2009 года. Начинает в 7 утра в субботу. Босс.
foes.role: босс: оглушает предметы в ряду, сносит стены
foes.look: a huge burly neighbor in a stretched white tank top, sweatpants and flip-flops, a hairy belly, a sunburnt bald head with a pencil behind the ear, safety goggles pushed up on the forehead, covered in grey plaster dust
foes.physics: plaster dust settles in the folds of the tank top and puffs off with every step, the sweatpants sag under the belly, and the flip-flops slap the floor
foes.split: bare arms, the sweatpants split at the knee
foes.props: a heavy industrial hammer drill with a long concrete bit, and a coiled orange extension cord

rollers.name: Тамагочи-переросток
rollers.joke: Умер от голода в 2003-м, потому что хозяин уехал на дачу. Помнит.
rollers.look: a giant egg-shaped handheld digital pet device made of scratched pastel-pink plastic, with three round buttons below a small pixel screen and a broken keychain chain dangling from the top loop
